thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API us-east queue growing rapidly. GPU pool us-east-1a at 96% allocation, queue length 18,200, p95 latency spike. Paging on-call: @oncall-ops

oncall-ops: I'm here. Any autoscaler errors? ETA on root cause?

eva-eng-sre: Autoscaler is repeatedly attempting VM create but cloud returns 429 rate_limit and a couple of OOM-style pool allocation errors: `QuotaExceeded: thin-pool-capacity` in the provisioner logs. Also seeing ~30% create_failures due to image-pull timeouts.

michael-eng-runtime: Runtime metrics: batching backlog skyrocketed. p95 jumped 2.1s -> 8.4s, p99 14s -> 42s. Several requests hit 30s client timeout and returned 504s. KV cache hit-rate dropped (cold start on many models).

sophie-support: We're getting multiple customer tickets: complaints about timeouts and slow responses. One enterprise reported 40% request failures in last 10m. Need status for customers.

josh-product: Priority: protect enterprise/Dedicated customers. Can we route paid traffic to Dedicated pools or degraded model variants? Also prepare a customer-facing note.

eva-eng-sre: Two-prong approach: 1) File cloud ticket for quota bump (INC-9876) and request immediate soft-quota increase. 2) Manual routing and model degradation for hosted: mark non-enterprise routes for fallback to smaller quantized variant. Doing (2) now. Logs snippet: ```provisioner: create(try=7) -> 429 QuotaExceeded: rate limit```

michael-eng-runtime: Initiating emergency rollout of rwd-3b-quant variant to non-critical tenants to reduce GPU memory pressure. Command used: ```/rollout model=rwd-3b-quant scope=noncritical mode=force```. Also enabling aggressive batching and cache TTL bump for inference.

sophie-support: Drafting status page: "Investigating elevated latencies and timeouts for API in us-east. Mitigations in progress; some customers may see degraded model quality as fallback." Want sign-off on wording.

oncall-ops: Handing off active response to @michael-eng-runtime (night shift) in 15m. I'll keep monitoring for 15m then tune incident status.

deploy-bot: rollout/rwd-3b-quant -> started by michael-eng-runtime. link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/5b2f... ETA ~3m :hourglass: 

eva-eng-sre: Cloud support granted temporary quota bump for 30 minutes to allow provisioning while we sort permanent limits. Provisioner succeeded for 6 extra nodes; queue dropped to ~4.2k. Monitoring p95/p99 now.

michael-eng-runtime: Observed latency improving after fallback and routing: p95 -> 2.7s, p99 -> 7.9s. Still above normal but stable. Continuing canary to roll back to default where capacity allows.

josh-product: Coordinate postmortem and customer outreach. Prioritize enterprise impacted list and propose SLA credit if threshold met.

oncall-ops: Closing pager for urgent escalation. Leaving incident open for follow-up and postmortem. If anything regresses ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
